title: POST /v1/messages request body
description: What the mock Anthropic server accepts. It pins the one wire shape this repository uses for structured output: `output_config.format = { type: "json_schema", schema: <JSON Schema> }`. The Node client reaches it through messages.parse() with an output-format helper and the Python client through messages.create() with a raw JSON Schema, so the mock never has to know which SDK called it. The body stays open at the top level because the Messages API keeps adding parameters; `output_config` and `format` are closed, because the point of this schema is to notice when that shape moves.

json_schema_format.description: The only output format this repository sends. `schema` is a JSON Schema object; its contents are the caller's business, so they are not constrained further here.
